01

File-System Routing

Create a .letswhim file to automatically generate a route. 

/project
  ├── index.letswhim   → /
  └── about.letswhim   → /about
02

Modular Components

Encapsulate UI logic into reusable files. Call them using the whim:tag syntax. 

<!-- components/card.letswhim -->
<whim:card title="Hello World" />
